headline: Approved $40,000 in youth climate project awards, including Project Bloom, Adding Rain Gardens, and Wall-e.
summary: Applications were ranked and sorted into funding tiers. Six more projects were recommended, some only with conditions, such as a new partner or approval from the Bloomberg Foundation. Light Up the Bike Path, RFS, and two roof projects were not recommended for funding, and their youth may join other projects.
decisions: Approved the October 14 meeting minutes unanimously.
Recommended funding for Project Bloom, Adding Rain Gardens, and Wall-e.
Recommended funding for six more youth projects, some with conditions.
Recommended an additional $2,000 for Project Bloom and an additional $1,050 for Why Should I Compost?
Decided not to recommend funding for Light Up the Bike Path, RFS, or either roof project.
Approved the youth climate project awards as laid out, totaling $40,000, by unanimous vote.
Tabled discussion of the agenda for future meetings.
Moved the next meeting to 11/18/26 at 5:30PM.
Tabled sharing of upcoming relevant events.

transcript:
# Climate Action & Sustainability Commission Agenda

Tuesday, October 27, 2026    5:30PM    Virtual Meeting

Meeting Link: https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetupjoin/19%3ameeting_YWQwMGVlMDMtYjBhYy00MzdmLWE1ZDItNGVjMDMwZmNlNDEw%40thread.v2/0?context=%7b%22Tid%22%3a%224a074cd1-7906-46af-b38f-90cd429d7f1b%22%2c%22Oid%22%3a%22651237f4-9307-4b52-8dcf-3f04c3fa328b%22%7d

Chair Ricky Ma called the meeting to order at 5:36PM.

## Roll Call (1 min)

- Councilor Carey McDonald - Absent
- Staff Liaison Rebekah McPheeters - Present
- Diego Maldonado\* (Secretary) - Absent
- Bob FitzPatrick\* - Present
- Rachel Surrette\* - Present
- Lipin Ji\* - Present
- Amanda Treat\* (Vice Chair) - Present
- Ricky Ma\* (Chair) – Present
- Arbin Tiimilsina - Present
- Julius “JJ” Scott (Youth Member) -Absent
- Naomi Yohannes (Youth Member) - Present

Also present: Julia Nassar (MAPC)

## Minutes to be Approved (4 min)

Commission to approve minutes from ~~September 14~~ (Correction) **October 14** meeting.

- Bob moved to approve the October 14 minutes. Amanda seconded the motion, and the commission voted unanimously to approve the minutes.

## Youth Climate Action Fund (YCAF) Application Review (50 min) - Ricky

Outline the plan for award communication to applicants. (5 min)

- Ricky noted that although this is a public meeting, commission members should wait to share any discussion details with applicants until finals decisions have been made
- Ricky reminded that the goal is to have lots of youth participation in the program

Group to discuss submitted applications.

Ricky to present data analysis regarding the group’s consolidated scores. (5 min)

- Ricky shared out the group’s collated rubric scores

Begin conversation with applications that had the widest ranging scores. (10 min) – Group decided not to take this approach.

Engage in tiered approach to awards (25 min):

1. Look at applications that the group wants to fund as is.
   a. Project Bloom (GMAACC), Adding Rain Gardens (FOMR), and Wall-e (FOMR), were the highest scoring applications. Everyone agreed these could move forward. The group recommended funding these projects.
   b. The group also recommended the following projects:
      i. Public Education Campaign, provided they switch their partner organization to Friends of the Fells
      ii. Youth Climate Summit, provided the Bloomberg Foundation deems this project allowable
      iii. Why Should I Compost?
      iv. Boba & Bikes, provided they undertake this project in partnership with Bike to the Sea
      v. Coytemore Lea Park Placekeeping Project
      vi. Building Garden Beds
2. Look at applications that the group wants to fund at a reduced or different budget.
   a. With the awards above, the group still had $3,050 left to award
   b. Group recommended the following:
      i. Offer an additional $2,000 to Project Bloom to use for gift cards for participants, more food, giveaways, other incentives, etc.
      ii. Offer an additional $1,050 to Why Should I Compost? To use for gift cards for participants, more food, giveaways, other incentives, etc.
   c. To facilitate this, we can ask those applicants to submit a new budget
   d. Here are the final award recommendations:

| | Original Amount | Additional/Reduction | Subtotal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Bloom | 1,750 | 2,000 | 3,750 |
| Rain garden | 5,000 | | 5,000 |
| Wall-E | 5,000 | | 5,000 |
| Public Education Campaign | 5,000 | | 5,000 |
| RFS | 5,000 | (5,000) | - |
| Youth Climate Summit | 4,200 | | 4,200 |
| Why should I compost | 1,000 | 1,050 | 2,050 |
| Coytemore Park | 5,000 | | 5,000 |
| Boba & Bikes | 5,000 | | 5,000 |
| Light up the bike path | 5,000 | (5,000) | - |
| Jabear Roof Care | 5,000 | (5,000) | - |
| Building Garden Beds | 5,000 | | 5,000 |
| Cool Roofs | 5,000 | (5,000) | - |
| Total | | | 40,000 |

3. If there are still funds left to award, look at the remaining applications and consider funding conditionally, based on edits to project or budget.
   a. Although the group decided not to recommend funding for Light Up the Bike Path, RFS, or either roof project, the group is going to suggest the following:
      i. Youth from Light Up the Bike Path join the Boba & Bikes project if desired
      ii. Youth from Jabear Roof Care join the Building Garden Beds project if desired
      iii. Youth from RFS join the Wall-E Initiative if desired
      iv. Youth from Cool Roofs join any other project if desired

Group to vote on award recommendations. (5 min)

- Bob motioned to approve the awards as laid out above. Amanda seconded the motion, and the group voted unanimously to approve the awards as laid out above.

## Next Steps (5 min)

Consider dates for award announcement.

- Group is hoping for official award announcement the week of 11/9.

Discuss agenda for next meeting.

For future meetings, consider YCAF debrief, MyRWA’s CLEANAIR presentation, Black Earth Compost.

- This item was tabled.

Schedule date/time for next meeting (the calendar invite falls on Veteran’s Day, so the group needs to reschedule).

- Decided to reschedule next meeting to 11/18/26 at 5:30PM.

Share out any upcoming relevant events.

- This item was tabled.

## Adjournment – 6:30PM

- Bob motioned to adjourn. Lipin seconded the motion, and the group voted unanimously to adjourn at 6:47PM.

*If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781-397-7000 Ext. 2005*
